text:
Interpreting "on the plate" as only the food on the paper plate: two fried eggs plus an English muffin sandwich with ham and cheese.

- Two fried eggs: about 100 g, roughly 180 kcal.
- English muffin: about 60 g, roughly 140 kcal.
- Ham and cheese: about 40 g, roughly 100 kcal.

That comes to about 420 kcal and 200 g in total.
